signature.one_line: Deadpan one-take office meme: boxed competitor-pain title, 'Meanwhile : us' pills, printed prop punchline.
unique_devices: 'Other X: pain / Meanwhile : us' structure: competitor pain in a big top title, the brand answer as two small white pills that hard-cut in on the right at ~30 % of runtime
Top title in black heavy italic geometric sans on merged white per-line rounded boxes, the pain phrase in accent
Punchline delivered as a physical printed one-word prop lifted to face height while both people point at it
Round brand badge top-right for the whole clip instead of an end card
signature.why_it_works: Names a familiar pain in the viewer's own register in frame one; the meme contrast resolves in a single visual gag with no reading after the turn.

hook.first_frame: Static office medium shot of two people, one standing and one seated at a desk, both deadpan to camera; white-boxed 2-line title at the top, round badge top-right

structure.what: Deadpan pair under the competitor-pain title
'Meanwhile :' + brand-name pills hard-cut in; a printed sheet starts coming up
One-word benefit sheet held at face height, both people point at it

background_text.how: Roman Hinglish, sentence case, ~10 words; Poppins 800 italic 58 px black, pain phrase accent; merged white per-line boxes (~10 px radius): line 1 box x 9.3-90.1 %, line 2 box x 5.6-93.9 %, together y 15.8-25.7 %; line 1 ink 16.7-19.1 %, line 2 ink 20.8-23.8 %; static from frame 0

Two white pills (radius ~8 px) on the right: pill 1 x 68.8-91.2 %, y 46.1-49.1 % with 'Meanwhile :' black Poppins 800 italic 33 px; pill 2 x 66.4-93.5 %, y 50.9-53.8 % with the brand name in two brand colours; gap 1.8 % H; both hard-cut in together at frame ~69, no pop
Circular logo badge top-right, x ~78-94 %, y ~5.5-14.5 % (~16 % W); static

layout.how: Subjects in the middle band (30-90 % H), clean wall/ceiling above for the title, right side kept clear at 45-55 % H for the pills

other_text_spec.copy: 'Other <competitors>: <pain phrase> / <rest of line>' in Roman Hinglish, 2 lines, ~10 words, sentence case, colon after the setup; the pain phrase in red (placeholder 'Other brands: KEY WORD here / lead words here')
other_text_spec.box: #FFFFFF per-line boxes merged into one shape with rounded corners (~10 px @1920, estimated): line 1 box x 9.3-90.1 %, line 2 box x 5.6-93.9 %, total y 15.8-25.7 %
other_text_spec.fit_note: solved upright; the italic slant adds little width

pills.text: <brand name> in two colours: first word deep teal-navy #0C3248, second word maroon #60261B, bold italic

other_text_spec.animation: both pills hard-cut in together (no pop, slide or fade), static to the end

other_text_spec.graphic: round logo badge (navy #364B72 and red #873C45 ring with white lettering)

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, warm: office fluorescent with warm wood and orange accents, neutral skin, phone-native

sound.music: non-speech trend sound with gaps (34 % silence, loudness range ~20 LU); heuristic labels it a music bed (~182 bpm estimate); no voice
sfx: optional: pop on the turn pills and a comedic sting on the prop reveal

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: the brand's edge over competitors fits one word (free, faster, cheaper, instant)
two people can act a deadpan reaction in one static take
the audience responds to meme formats in Roman-script Hinglish (or the brand's language)
the piece must stay in the micro duration class
avoid_when: comparative claims need legal care or proof
the message needs explanation or speech
the brand voice is formal or premium
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B10 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B10.json) to this brand.
No speech captions: a one-take meme skit whose editing is two text layers plus a badge. Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} and {{ACCENT}} >= 4.5:1 on {{SURFACE}} boxes; the pain phrase must stay a warning-type hue distinct from the brand colours)
- {{TEXT}}: title and 'Meanwhile' text, default #000000
- {{ACCENT}}: competitor pain phrase, default #E00006
- {{ACCENT_2}}: brand name word 1 on the pill, default #0C3248 (word 2 default #60261B)
- {{SURFACE}}: title boxes and pills, default #FFFFFF
- {{CARD_BG}}: unused, default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Poppins 800 italic
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Poppins 800 italic
- {{HANDLE}}: not shown in the source
- {{LOGO}}: round badge top-right for the whole clip

TITLE
1. Copy: "Other <competitors>: <pain phrase> / <rest of line>" in the audience's register (source: Roman Hinglish), 2 lines, ~10 words, sentence case; the pain phrase in {{ACCENT}} ("Other brands: KEY WORD here / lead words here").
2. {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 58 px, tracking 0; text {{TEXT}}, key phrase {{ACCENT}}; no stroke or shadow.
3. Box: {{SURFACE}} behind each line, merged into one shape with ~10 px rounded corners (line 1 box x 9.3-90.1 %, line 2 box x 5.6-93.9 %, together y 15.8-25.7 %). Lines centred: line 1 ink 16.7-19.1 %, line 2 ink 20.8-23.8 % H (a ~31-character line spans ~83.9 % W at 3.0 % H).
4. Timing: on from frame 0 to the end, static.

OTHER TEXT
5. Turn pills at the joke's turn (~30 % of runtime), both hard-cut in together, static to the end: {{SURFACE}} pills (radius ~8 px) on the right. Pill 1 x 68.8-91.2 %, y 46.1-49.1 % with "Meanwhile :" in {{TEXT}} {{FONT_BODY}} 33 px; pill 2 x 66.4-93.5 %, y 50.9-53.8 % with the brand name, first word {{ACCENT_2}}, second word the brand's second colour. Gap 1.8 % H.
6. {{LOGO}} round badge top-right (x ~78-94 %, y ~5.5-14.5 %), static, whole clip. Deliver the punchline as a physical printed one-word prop ("KEY WORD !!") lifted to face height while both people point at it; no typed punchline.

EDIT
7. One locked medium two-shot, deadpan to camera, no cuts or zooms; keep the right side at 45-55 % H clear for the pills.

SOUND: a non-speech trend sound or comedic sting with gaps; optional pop on the pills. Master to about -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, warm office light, neutral skin.

VERIFY before rendering: render the title and pills and measure:
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at 1.0 --box 0.05,0.2,0.95,0.24 --ink "#000000:90"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at 3.0 --box 0.66,0.46,0.93,0.49 --ink "#000000:90"
Title line 2 (run the {{TEXT}} and {{ACCENT}} inks, e.g. --ink "#E00006:90", and combine): compute the expected ink for the brand's line with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py at 58 px (a ~31-character line reads ~3.0 % H / 83.9 % W); "Meanwhile :" must read 1.33 % +-0.5 of H and 19.3 % +-2 of W. Box/pill positions within +-1 % of frame height.
